summary.text: Dan Dawson, a Republican, represents District 10 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Dawson as serving a third term.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Dawson as a special agent with the Iowa Division of Criminal Investigation and as a Chief Warrant Officer 4 in the Iowa Army National Guard with 26 years of service.

It says Dawson graduated from Abraham Lincoln High School in Council Bluffs, received a B.S. in criminal justice administration from Bellevue University, was born in 1978 in Omaha, Nebraska, and lives in Council Bluffs.
